title: The stock traits to prioritize when rotating out of risk
title_zh: 摆脱风险时应优先考虑的股票特征
summary: As more investors pivot out of high-risk sectors — especially after February's software stock sell-off sparked by AI concerns — CIBC Capital Markets managing director and head of equity & portfolio strategy, Chris Harvey explains the characteristics that he is looking for in s...
summary_zh: 随着越来越多的投资者撤离高风险行业——尤其是在 2 月份因人工智能担忧引发软件股抛售之后——CIBC 资本市场董事总经理兼股票和投资组合策略主管 Chris Harvey 解释了他在软件股票中寻找的特征。

title: The Big Tech losers as AI fears wipe billions of dollars off valuations
title_zh: 由于对人工智能的担忧，大型科技公司的输家使估值损失了数十亿美元
summary: Concerns over risks to Microsoft's AI business and growing competition from Google ‌and Anthropic have wiped roughly $613 billion off its market value.
summary_zh: 对微软人工智能业务风险的担忧以及来自谷歌和 Anthropic 日益激烈的竞争已使其市值蒸发约 6130 亿美元。

title: Gold prices dip as investors book profits
title_zh: 随着投资者获利了结，金价下跌
summary: Thin holiday trading and profit-taking pushed bullion lower
summary_zh: 假日交易清淡和获利回吐推低金价

title: Fund Beating 99% of Peers Sees Few Software Firms Surviving AI
title_zh: 击败 99% 同行的基金发现很少有软件公司能在人工智能中幸存
summary: “We think application software faces an existential threat from AI,” said Evans, whose $12 billion global technology fund beat 99% of peers over one year and 97% over five.
summary_zh: 埃文斯表示：“我们认为应用软件面临着来自人工智能的生存威胁。”他的 120 亿美元全球技术基金在一年内击败了 99% 的同行，在五年内击败了 97% 的同行。

title: China's humanoid robots ready for Lunar New Year showtime
title_zh: 中国仿人机器人准备迎接农历新年表演
summary: China's most-watched TV show, the annual CCTV Spring Festival gala, will be viewed later on Monday as a showcase for the country's cutting-edge industrial policy and Beijing's push to dominate humanoid robots and the future of manufacturing.
summary_zh: 中国收视率最高的电视节目，一年一度的中央电视台春节联欢晚会，将于周一晚些时候播出，展示中国前沿的产业政策以及北京推动人形机器人和制造业未来主导地位的努力。

title: House prices 'stand still' in February at an average £368,019
title_zh: 2月份房价“停滞不前”，平均为368,019英镑
summary: House prices in Britain have held steady in February, with the average price of a newly listed home coming in at £368,019, says Rightmove.
summary_zh: Rightmove 表示，2 月份英国房价保持稳定，新上市房屋的平均价格为 368,019 英镑。

title: Rampant AI Demand for Memory Is Fueling a Growing Chip Crisis
title_zh: 人工智能对内存的旺盛需求正在加剧日益严重的芯片危机
summary: Since the start of 2026, Tesla Inc., Apple Inc. and a dozen other major corporations have signaled that the shortage of DRAM, or dynamic random access memory — the fundamental building block of almost all technology — will constrain production.
summary_zh: 自 2026 年初以来，特斯拉公司、苹果公司和其他十几家大公司已表示，动态随机存取存储器（几乎所有技术的基本组成部分）的短缺将限制生产。

title: Nvidia earnings are going to be a tell-tale sign for markets
title_zh: 英伟达的财报将成为市场的一个明显迹象
summary: RBC Wealth Management technical strategist Rob Sluymer explains how Nvidia (NVDA), as a leader among mega-cap tech stocks and AI trade player, will be a major indicator for the market (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) when it reports its fourth quarter earnings results on February 25.
summary_zh: 加拿大皇家银行财富管理技术策略师 Rob Sluymer 解释了英伟达 (NVDA) 作为大型科技股和人工智能交易领域的领导者，在 2 月 25 日公布第四季度盈利结果时将如何成为市场的主要指标（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）。

title: 'The dark side of AI': Wall Street weighs recent stock sell-off over disruption fears
title_zh: “人工智能的阴暗面”：华尔街因担心颠覆而权衡近期股票抛售
summary: Investor concerns over AI's disruption drove a stock market sell-off in the wealth management, transportation, and logistics industries.
summary_zh: 投资者对人工智能颠覆的担忧推动了财富管理、运输和物流行业的股市抛售。
